```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Identify full-width and full-height separator lines.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    def intervals(size, separators):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for p in separators:
            if start < p:
                result.append((start, p))
            start = p + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result

    row_parts = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    col_parts = intervals(w, sep_cols)

    # The common non-separator value is the background; the other value
    # occurring within cells is the marker.
    sep_color = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else None
    background = next(
        grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_parts for c0, c1 in col_parts
        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
        if grid[r][c] != sep_color
    )
    marker = next(
        grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_parts for c0, c1 in col_parts
        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
        if grid[r][c] not in (sep_color, background)
    )

    out = [[background for _ in col_parts] for _ in row_parts]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_parts):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_parts):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            if count == 2:
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out
```
